svg.text: overall 67.3% · iPhone 4S (A5) running iOS 6.1.3 at the speed of the real phone, on Windows, then Android · updated 2026-10-19
MSYS2 UCRT64, QEMU 11.0.3 links; MinGW fixes upstreamable
IPSW to kboot, rootfs, PPN NAND store, the install boot's two helpers (static and dyld-linked) and ramdisk; the IPSW's AppleLogo decoded and on the panel from reset (K48SEG), as iBoot leaves it

M2/M3: launchd, every daemon, SpringBoard; first boot to Setup 115 s, normal boot to the lock screen 70 s; no daemon crash: assistantd's kill at boot was AudioToolbox's 5 s session timeout against the emulator's pace (60 s, a per-firmware edit); console errors only from unmodeled blocks and radios
Storage: IOP, PPN NAND, FTL, NVRAM

FTL formats and opens, IONVRAM up, system volume as marker pages (B3), effaceable storage (B4), the FMI's inline AES; the store's host cost cut (known-erased pages, page runs, marker-page map): create 97->69 s, first boot to Setup 175->115 s; 12 GC-heavy install sessions with 0 page errors

data volume (journaled, protected) with the IPSW's /private/var skeleton, NVRAM, FTL, effaceable lockers, keybag and the FMI's inline AES across boots; iOS's power-off (codec power-down, PMU standby: QEMU exits), iOS's own reboot and a killed QEMU all come back to the lock screen with fsck clean

both cores (-smp 2, MTTCG; device boot's default): enable_core is the PMGR's 'Core' (0x1214/0x1220), cpu1 starts at its reset vector; hw.ncpu = 2 read from the kernel; lock screen at 55 s on two cores against 78 s on one; 10 min there with no panic
vectors, masks, per-CPU timers and IPIs on both cores; an IACK claims a vector for its core (both handled the same IRQ before); TIME_LO/HI read with no BQL (mach_absolute_time)
PMGR clocks, GPIO, DWI, watchdog, PL310

every boot access modeled (-d unimp shows none): the A5 PMGR's perf, power and config registers, the watchdog at +0x3020 (a guest panic restarts the machine through 'WDTr'), DWI, the PL310's cif window, GPIO NPL, arm-io's bus registers; the A5 clock table typed by the kext's own slot names (real 4S values unknown)

ADC muxes identified; accelerometer and gyro start (nominal calibration in the kboot DT); bq27540 gauge on uart5; the level follows vbat through the kext's battery curve (84% and charging on the lock screen's status bar, lockdown alike); Home/power latch the PMU's EVENT_A wake bits ('STAT' 0x180/0x181)

CDMA and its AES filter carry SecureRoot, the keybag and content protection with no CDMA error; PKE matched (AppleSamsungPKE), unused by a boot; the A5's SHA-2 block has no driver in 10B329 (corecrypto hashes in software), so nothing to model

tools/dev/usbmux_bridge.py: the host's usbmuxd over the fork's tcp_usb link, started by device boot; ideviceinfo (paired, SSL with tools/dev/openssl-ios6.cnf) shows ProductVersion 6.1.3, AFC round-trips files; HSIC radios absent cleanly (DEVICE_READY low, bounded retries)
Setup Assistant on screen (M3): AppleCLCD adopts the framebuffer, CoreAnimation (software, or the GL bridge) swaps through the A5 layer MMU; RGBOUT/TV-out open
CoreAnimation composites through ANGLE/D3D11 up to Setup (front end built without macOS); home screen and apps on it, and a speed-up over software, still open
M4: the spi1 multi-touch nub stays busy (no digitizer model); A4 Z2 models to adapt
AE2 coprocessor modeled high-level, I2S blocks, codec and Highland Park start, mediaserverd up; no PCM to the host yet, AE2 audio endpoints unread
baseband unmatched, HSIC ports time out cleanly; stubs for M4
Speed: 1:1 with a real 4S on PC
MTTCG, WFI, profiling; measured after M3
